irregularities.finding: Legacy evaluator `src/gems85/holdout.py` (`gems85-holdout-v1.0.0`) removes a `5-px` (`500 m`) buffer of real mapped faults from `fold.visible` AND then only masks `pred[fold.visible] = 0.0` during scoring (unlike `vendor/gems57/holdout.py`, which masks `masked_known = cat & ~hidden`). Consequently, models that accurately detect real mapped fault strands inside that `5-px` collar are penalized as false positives under `gems85-holdout-v1.0.0`, whereas pure label-blind `EXP1` (`HOLDOUT-DTI = 0.131399` vs `CTRL_d28 = 0.111529`) sets a clean all-time record on `gems85-holdout-v1.0.0`.
irregularities.action_taken: Preserved unmodified shared scoring math and reported all four evaluators transparently in `evidence/hjcd_experiments.json` and on the site.
